items.title_en: US preliminarily finds Vietnam-finished steel wheels using Chinese hot-rolled steel circumvent China orders
items.title_original: Certain Steel Wheels from the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Affirmative Determination of Circumvention of the Antidumping Duty and Countervailing Duty Orders
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部11月24日公布A-570-082、C-570-083全国性肯定初裁，涉及用中国原产热轧钢在越南组装或制成并输美的涉案钢制车轮。拟指示美国海关对2026年3月19日起报关进口或从保税仓提取进入消费、且尚未清算的涉案报关单暂停清算并收取反倾销及反补贴预估保证金。原令主要涵盖名义直径22.5和24.5英寸的商用车无内胎道路钢轮、轮辋和轮辐，参考税号包括8708.70.4530、8708.70.4560、8708.70.6030、8708.70.6060、8716.90.5045及8716.90.5059，铝轮、钢材重量占比不足50%的车轮及部分有内胎车轮排除。非中国热轧基料生产的越南车轮在本次调查范围外，但报关仍需核查认证，NCC Vietnam等企业须证明具备认证资格。本次初裁没有独立新税率表，保证金适用既有令和海关执行指令。书面意见于公布后14日内提交，反驳为其后7日，听证请求为公布后30日内。
items.summary_en: On 24 November Commerce issued a country-wide affirmative preliminary finding under A-570-082 and C-570-083. It will instruct CBP to suspend liquidation and collect estimated AD/CVD deposits for covered unliquidated entries from 19 March 2026. The written order covers specified on-road steel wheels, rims and discs, primarily 22.5 and 24.5 inches. Non-Chinese hot-rolled inputs fall outside this inquiry, subject to evidence and certification requirements. Initial briefs are due 14 days after publication.
items.impact_zh: 如供应车轮用热轧料，按越南客户的成品用途及输美订单排查风险。请越南车轮厂与美国进口商核对3月19日起未清算单据、卷号和原产地证明、认证资格及保证金率，确认后方可锁定含税价格和清关安排。
items.impact_en: For hot-rolled steel supplied to Vietnamese wheel manufacturers, identify US-bound covered wheels. Ask the manufacturer and US importer to check entries still unliquidated since 19 March, coil-level origin evidence, certification eligibility and applicable deposits before committing to duty-paid pricing.

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that imports of certain steel wheels (steel wheels), completed in the Socialist Republic of Vietnam (Vietnam) using hot- rolled steel (HRS) produced in the People's Republic of China (China), are circumventing the antidumping duty (AD) and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on steel wheels from China. Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.

items.title_original: Certain Corrosion-Resistant Steel Products From the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Negative Determination of Circumvention of the Antidumping Duty and Countervailing Duty Orders
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部11月24日公布A-570-026、C-570-027的全国性否定初裁。3月25日立案后，本次认定限于印尼用中国热轧或冷轧基料制成并从印尼输美的特定耐腐蚀钢板（CORE），调查期2021年1月1日至2025年12月31日。产品包括符合书面范围的镀锌、镀铝或其他耐腐蚀金属镀层钢板，原令参考税号有7210.49.0030及7210.61.0000，镀锡板、无锡钢等有明确排除。本公告未指示基于本次初裁新增保证金。商务部将开展核查，书面意见日期另行通知，反驳期为案情陈述截止后7日，听证请求为公告后30日内。
items.summary_en: Commerce issued a country-wide negative preliminary finding on 24 November under A-570-026 and C-570-027. It covers specified CORE completed in Indonesia using Chinese hot- or cold-rolled steel for US export, with a 2021–2025 inquiry period. The notice does not instruct new deposits on the basis of this finding. Verification and further comments precede the final determination.
items.impact_zh: 印尼镀层钢加工使用中国基料的输美报价有望减少一项反规避风险。请进口商逐票核对基料、印尼实际工序、产品范围及其他适用税费，并在合同中约定终裁变化后的成本分担。
items.impact_en: The ruling reduces one preliminary risk for Indonesian coated output from Chinese substrate. Verify substrate, Indonesian processing, scope and other US duties with the importer; allocate final-ruling risk in contracts.

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines on a country-wide basis that imports of certain corrosion- resistant steel products (CORE) completed in Indonesia using hot-rolled steel (HRS) or cold-rolled steel (CRS) manufactured in the People's Republic of China (China) are not circumventing the antidumping duty (AD) and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on CORE from China. The period of inquiry is January 1, 2021, through December 31, 2025. Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.

items.summary_zh: 安永Alwyn Hopkins在2026年11月19日伦敦活动上称，欧盟钢铁产品进口在2025年12月比以往12月均值高65%，在2026年1月比以往1月均值低27%。两项数据分别与对应月份的历史均值比较。他认为，部分进口商可能在欧盟CBAM于2026年1月1日进入正式阶段前提前安排进口，钢铁保障措施和关税也可能影响同期变化。原报道未列明历史样本年份、纳入税号或各因素的贡献。
items.summary_en: At a London event on 19 November 2026, EY's Alwyn Hopkins said EU iron and steel imports were 65% above the historical December average in December 2025 and 27% below the historical January average in January 2026. He suggested CBAM front-loading could have contributed, alongside safeguards and tariffs. The report provides neither the baseline years nor the commodity-code coverage.

items.title_zh: 研究称2019—2025年拉美直接及间接钢材进口增46.1%，中国在六大产钢国进口份额升至39%
items.title_en: Secondary analysis: Latin American direct and indirect steel imports rose 46.1% in 2019–25; China share of LAC6 imports reached 39%
items.title_original: 拉美钢铁进口增长46.1%至7200万吨，中国份额升至39% - 新闻和统计
items.summary_zh: 【研究报道，非海关钢材进口统计】IndexBox 2026年11月20日引述Mesteel和经合组织(OECD)研究称，2019—2025年拉美直接进口钢材及嵌入制成品的间接钢材进口合计增长46.1%，2025年达到约7200万吨；阿根廷、巴西、智利、哥伦比亚、墨西哥和秘鲁六国(LAC6)直接及间接钢材进口从3760万吨升至5540万吨，来自中国的对应供应从910万吨升至2160万吨，占比由24%升至39%。报道还称间接进口约占相关供应40%，LAC6钢厂产能利用率约60%。以上口径含汽车、机械、设备等成品所含钢材，不等于7200万吨钢材海关进口量；本轮核对了IndexBox全文，未取得并逐表复算OECD原始报告。
items.summary_en: IndexBox (20 Nov), citing Mesteel/OECD, reports Latin American direct-plus-indirect steel imports up 46.1% in 2019–25 to 72 Mt. China's share of LAC6 direct-plus-indirect imports reportedly rose from 24% to 39% (9.1 to 21.6 Mt). Figures include steel embedded in manufactured goods, not solely customs-recorded steel imports. Original OECD tables were not independently verified.
items.impact_zh: 【业务研判】拉美钢材竞争压力及贸易救济风险值得跟踪，但不能将39%直接用作中国成品钢材在拉美市场的海关进口份额。出口报价应分别分析各国热轧、冷轧、镀锌及板坯的直接进口量、原产地限制和贸易救济，特别关注墨西哥、巴西及哥伦比亚。该报告显示的进口渗透率变化可作为市场背景，不应替代逐国逐税号统计。
items.impact_en: The study signals competitive pressure in Latin America but the 39% figure is not China's customs share of steel imports. Validate direct imports and trade remedies by country and HS code before pricing.
items.source_excerpt: 拉美钢铁进口增长46.1%至7200万吨，中国份额升至39% - 新闻和统计 IndexBox
items.follow_up: 取得OECD原报告，分拆直接/间接进口并与Alacero、各国海关按HS编码核对；再分析首钢板卷、板坯目标市场。

items.title_en: Norway and Iceland to apply EU CBAM from 1 January 2027 with a combined 50-tonne threshold
items.title_original: EU extends Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism to Iceland and Norway from 2027
items.summary_zh: 欧洲经济区联合委员会第283/2026号决定于2026年11月18日生效，将经修订的欧盟CBAM条例纳入欧洲经济区协定。自2027年1月1日起，挪威和冰岛适用同一套机制。钢铁、铝、化肥和水泥的50吨年度净重门槛按同一进口商在欧盟、挪威和冰岛的相关进口量合计，氢和电力不适用吨位门槛。授权在三地互认。当地设立的进口商在2027年3月31日前提交申请可按规定使用本地进口的过渡安排；欧委会同时提示地方进口身份标识TIN与欧盟EORI应分别核对。列支敦士登不适用本决定纳入的条例。
items.summary_en: EEA Joint Committee Decision 283/2026 entered into force on 18 November 2026 and extends EU CBAM to imports into Norway and Iceland from 1 January 2027. The 50-tonne annual net-mass threshold for covered goods in four sectors, including iron and steel, is aggregated per importer across the EU, Norway and Iceland. Electricity and hydrogen have no mass threshold. Authorisations are mutually recognised. Importers established in Norway or Iceland may qualify for local transitional treatment if they submit their application by 31 March 2027. Local TIN and EU EORI requirements should be checked separately. Liechtenstein is excluded.
items.impact_zh: 首票预计在2027年清关的对挪威、冰岛板坯、热卷、冷卷或涂镀订单，按附件税号、当地进口商的跨境累计吨位和预计进口季度估算CBAM成本，要求进口商确认授权、当地TIN及适用的过渡条件。DDP订单应在合同中落实碳成本和钢厂排放数据交付责任。
items.impact_en: For covered slab, HRC, CRC or coated products entering Norway or Iceland in 2027, verify the tariff line, the importer’s combined volumes, authorisation and local TIN. Build CBAM into landed costs for the expected entry quarter and specify carbon-cost and emissions-data responsibilities for DDP orders.

items.summary_zh: ECIU报告引用CBI Economics分析。按贸易额计，2024年欧盟占英国钢材出口的67%、进口的66%。报告表1用英国热轧卷产品默认排放值2.649–3.778 tCO₂e/吨和HMRC示例费率£9.69/tCO₂e，测得约£26–37/吨。中国热轧卷按欧盟默认值及2026年第三季度证书价€82.32测得约€179/吨（2026年进口），同一证价套用2027年参数约€208/吨。上述为报告情景，币种、年份及免费配额调整口径不同。
items.summary_en: ECIU draws on CBI Economics analysis. In 2024 the EU accounted for 67% of UK steel exports and 66% of imports by value. Table 1 models UK hot-rolled coil at around GBP 26–37/t using product defaults of 2.649–3.778 tCO₂e/t and HMRC’s illustrative GBP 9.69/tCO₂e rate. Chinese hot-rolled coil using EU defaults and the Q3 2026 certificate price of EUR 82.32 is modelled at about EUR 179/t for 2026 imports or EUR 208/t under 2027 parameters at the same price. The scenarios use different currencies, years and free-allocation adjustments.
items.impact_zh: 对英国和欧盟分别按进口期、商品编码、对应排放数据及进口商可申报扣减核算到岸成本，再叠加各自的配额关税和贸易救济措施。报告所示差异值得纳入英国与欧盟报价的情景敏感性，实际订单按当期公布参数复算。欧英ETS联动及可能的互惠豁免见欧委会公告，按各项原产地规则及生效日期确认适用性。
items.impact_en: Calculate landed costs separately for each market using the import period, commodity code, applicable emissions data and relief available to the importer. Add any applicable tariff-quota and trade-remedy charges. Use the report as a sensitivity case and reprice against the rates in force. Check the Commission notice and applicable origin and effective-date rules for the ETS link and possible reciprocal exemptions.

items.title_zh: 欧委会2025年碳市场报告：欧盟工业ETS排放下降3.3%，CBAM扩至180类下游产品仍为提案
items.title_en: Commission's 2025 carbon market report: industrial ETS emissions down 3.3%; extension of CBAM to 180 downstream goods remains proposed
items.title_original: Industrial emissions in the EU fell by 3.3%; CBAM to be extended to 180 products
items.summary_zh: 【官方报告事实】欧委会于2026年11月9日发布COM(2026)596 final《2025年欧洲碳市场运行报告》。报告以截至2026年6月30日的核证数据指出，2025年欧盟ETS工业设施排放较2024年下降3.3%，主要由钢铁、水泥和化工部门推动；陶瓷和铝业排放则增加逾2%。整个ETS1（含电力、工业、航空、航运）2025年排放量约11.63亿吨二氧化碳当量，较2024年下降2%。报告第3.4节回顾欧委会2025年12月提出的CBAM下游扩围方案，拟自2028年覆盖约180类钢铝密集型产品（如洗衣机、工业散热器、铸造机械），并拟设临时脱碳基金；此处是既有立法提案回顾，尚非2026年11月新增已生效税目。报告提及CBAM覆盖行业免费配额逐步退出，不能把工业排放下降直接等同于钢铁单吨排放强度下降。
items.summary_en: COM(2026)596 final, published 9 Nov 2026, reports verified 2025 industrial ETS emissions down 3.3% y/y, mainly in steel, cement and chemicals; ceramic and aluminium emissions rose over 2%. Total ETS1 emissions were 1,163 MtCO2e, down 2%. The report reiterates the December 2025 Commission proposal to extend CBAM to around 180 steel/aluminium-intensive downstream goods from 2028; this remains a proposal, not an enacted new product list.
items.impact_zh: 【业务研判】欧盟钢铁排放下降可能同时反映减产、结构调整和减排，不能据此推断欧洲钢厂竞争成本必然下降。中国钢材及下游出口企业应监测欧盟ETS免费配额和CBAM扩围立法进度，预先建立钢铝前驱体、产品CN编码及嵌入排放数据映射；扩围尚未生效，不应提前按180项方案向客户计征CBAM。欧盟拟设出口脱碳补助若获通过可能改变欧洲制造商的海外竞争报价，但具体资金和适用条件须待立法落地。
items.impact_en: The 3.3% drop may reflect lower output as well as decarbonisation, not necessarily lower unit emissions or costs. Chinese steel and downstream exporters should track free-allocation reforms and the CBAM expansion proposal, map CN codes and embedded emissions, and avoid treating the 180 proposed goods as currently taxable.

items.summary_en: Kalkine reported a $485/t FOB assessment for Chinese SS400 HRC on 16 November. SEAISI’s Mysteel report placed 3 mm SS400 at the same level, FOB Tianjin, on 13 November. Kalkine linked cautious European buying to quota limits. The EU regulation specifies a 50% out-of-quota duty for covered categories when quota is exhausted or unavailable. Check the relevant origin, product category, quota order and entry date.

items.title_original: Australia launches review of antidumping duties on steel plate imports from China and South Korea
items.summary_zh: 澳大利亚反倾销复审委员会于2026年11月18日应宝山钢铁股份有限公司和宝钢湛江申请，对9月24日公布的第2026/103号反倾销决定启动复审。争议涉及巴西板坯基准是否应覆盖铁矿石成本、能否采用经核实的浦项板坯成本及损害归因。范围为未包覆或涂镀、非卷状、厚度≥4.75毫米、宽度≥600毫米的非合金或其他合金扁平轧材，包括钢坯直轧板和热卷开平板。参考税号7208.40.00、7208.51.00、7208.52.00、7208.90.00、7225.40.00。不锈钢、硅电工钢、工具钢、高速钢、调质板及指定调质母板排除，登记册还列有部长豁免，例如符合标准的S355JR且厚度超过115毫米的部分热轧板，须结合生产方式及具体豁免文书核对。现行登记册公布的有效税率为宝山18.8%、湛江9.4%、涟钢26.4%、中国其他出口商55.1%、韩国浦项豁免、韩国其他出口商21.6%。宝山和中国其他出口商栏包含独立反补贴措施，组合反倾销税的实际税负可能高于公示有效税率。复审尚未修改现行措施。书面意见截止2026年12月18日，复审报告预计2027年1月18日提交部长。
items.summary_en: On 18 November 2026, Australia’s Anti-Dumping Review Panel opened a review of the 24 September decision ADN 2026/103 on applications from Baoshan and Baosteel Zhanjiang. It will examine slab benchmarking and injury attribution. The scope includes uncoated, non-coiled non-alloy and other alloy plate, at least 4.75 mm thick by 600 mm wide, including cut-to-length plate made from coil, subject to material and grade exclusions. A ministerial instrument also exempts certain S355JR plates over 115 mm meeting the specified production and standard requirements. Published effective rates are 18.8% for Baoshan, 9.4% for Zhanjiang, 26.4% for Hunan Valin Lianyuan, 55.1% for other Chinese exporters, exempt for POSCO and 21.6% for other Korean exporters. Baoshan’s and the Chinese residual rate include a separate countervailing measure; actual combination duties can exceed the published effective rates. Submissions close on 18 December 2026 and the panel’s report is due on 18 January 2027.
items.impact_zh: 有在手输澳中厚板、花纹板或开平板询单时，先由进口商逐票匹配牌号、尺寸、出口商和DSN，并核实组合反倾销税适用的出口价格基准及实际税负。继续按现行措施核算DDP或到岸总成本；拟提交意见的企业及早准备成本和损害证据，并按公告要求提供可公开版本。
items.impact_en: For Australian plate or cut-to-length orders, have the importer match the grade, dimensions, exporter and DSN and check the applicable price basis and combination duty. Keep current trade-remedy costs in landed quotes, and prepare supporting evidence and a public version if making a submission.

items.title_zh: 英国对韩国热轧中厚板实施最终反倾销税：现代7.04%、浦项12.19%，宽度超过2100毫米为0%
items.title_en: UK imposes definitive AD duties on South Korean hot-rolled plate: Hyundai 7.04%, POSCO 12.19%, width over 2,100 mm 0%
items.title_original: Trade remedies notice: hot-rolled steel plates originating from South Korea (anti-dumping)
items.summary_zh: 【正式公告】英国政府2026年11月18日发布贸易救济通知2026/32，自11月19日实施、期限五年至2031年11月19日。针对原产韩国的特定非卷状热轧中厚板（涉及7208、7210、7225下11个税号，通常厚度≥4.75毫米并有产品排除项），按宽度区分：≤2100毫米的韩国生产商现代钢铁7.04%（附加码8A78）、POSCO 12.19%（8A79）、其他23.07%（8A80）；>2100毫米适用0%（8A81），均为同一最终反倾销措施的一部分。税基为进口英国边境未完税净价。享受指定生产商税率需有效商业发票附签字声明；否则适用剩余税率。该决定拒绝TRA对全范围征税5.98%—25.71%的建议，并终止此前进口登记。不得把TRA建议税率当成最终税率。
items.summary_en: UK notice 2026/32 published 18 Nov and effective 19 Nov 2026 to 19 Nov 2031. For Korean hot-rolled plate ≤2,100 mm: Hyundai Steel 7.04% (8A78), POSCO 12.19% (8A79), others 23.07% (8A80). Plate >2,100 mm attracts 0% (8A81). Specific invoice declarations are required for producer-specific rates. The Secretary of State rejected the TRA's broader recommended rates.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】英国进口商采购韩国中厚板的到岸成本将按实际制造商与2100毫米宽度阈值分化，宽板韩国货仍可保持零反倾销税竞争力。中国板材可能获得局部替代询价，但必须独立核对中国原产货物适用的英国贸易救济、保障措施、UK CBAM及客户认证，不可视为自动获益。跟踪韩国≤2100毫米中厚板是否转向其他市场属于预测，尚无证据确认。建议对英国客户按生产厂、宽度、税号、附加码及商业发票逐项核价。
items.impact_en: Korean plate costs now vary materially by producer and the 2,100 mm threshold. Chinese substitution is only a possibility subject to separate UK measures, quotas, carbon obligations and customer approvals. Monitor potential diversion without treating it as established.

items.title_zh: 欧盟CBAM于2027年1月1日扩展至挪威和冰岛，50吨门槛跨三地累计
items.title_en: EU CBAM extends to Norway and Iceland from 1 January 2027
items.title_original: Extension of CBAM to Iceland and Norway
items.summary_zh: 欧委会税务与海关总司2026年11月18日官方公告确认，EEA联合委员会第283/2026号决定于11月18日生效；2027年1月1日起挪威和冰岛进口CBAM覆盖货物适用相同规则。钢铁、铝、化肥、水泥年度50吨门槛在欧盟、挪威和冰岛合计计算，电力和氢不适用该吨数门槛；三地授权申报人资格相互承认。挪威和冰岛进口商须办理授权，2027年3月31日前申请者有过渡便利；列支敦士登不在CBAM区域。
items.summary_en: EEA Decision 283/2026 entered into force 18 Nov. From 1 Jan 2027 CBAM extends to Norway and Iceland. The 50-tonne annual threshold for four sectors is cumulative across the EU and both EEA states; authorisations are mutually recognised.
items.impact_zh: 向挪威及冰岛出口板坯、热轧/冷轧等涉案产品需准备CBAM排放数据，并与欧洲集团进口商核对跨三地累计进口量及授权状态；不能将50吨门槛分拆适用。
items.impact_en: Steel exporters should prepare emissions data and coordinate group-wide import volumes and declarant authorisations across the three customs territories.
items.source_excerpt: Extension of CBAM to Iceland and Norway EEA Joint Committee Decision No 283/2026, which extends CBAM to Iceland and Norway, entered into force on 18 November 2026. From 1 January 2027, the same CBAM rules will apply to imports of covered goods into Iceland and Norway as to imports into the EU.
